The _git helper library is part of bash-os and is covered by the project's
MIT licence, in LICENSE at the top of this repository. It contains no
third-party code.

Its formats — loose objects, the index, packfiles and the wire protocol —
are implemented from their published descriptions. No code is copied or
translated from git, which is licensed under GPL-2.0.

The collision-detecting SHA-1 it calls lives in ../_sha1dc/, with its own
notice.
